internal_discovery.plain_explanation: In the Quran the letters k-l-l never form a verb; all 377 uses are nominal. 374 of them are the familiar quantifier kull ('every/each/all') plus its compound kullama ('whenever'), which reliably means 'the whole of a set, leaving nothing out' - read as 'every single one' with an indefinite word and as 'all of them together' with a definite word. The remaining 3 are different words that only share the same consonants: kall (16:76), 'a burden/dependent who can do nothing, weighing on his master', and kalala (4:12, 4:176), a legal inheritance term for someone who dies with no parent and no child. The Quran never links these three senses to each other, so the honest result is one strong dominant quantifier family plus two isolated resistant nominals - a multi-class root, not a single meaning.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: kull does NOT lexicalize the every/whole distinction itself (the complement does); it is NOT partitive ('some'), NOT 'many/most', and asserts exhaustion with no exception even in hyperbolic 'kull shay' (domain is context-bounded, e.g. 46:25 'destroys everything' yet only dwellings remain). The root carries NO verbal/eventive sense anywhere (no 'grow weary / blunt / crown' - those have zero textual footprint and are barred). kull carries no evaluative load and presupposes enumerable members/kinds, not an undivided continuum. The quantifier nucleus does NOT reach 'burden/dependency' (kall, 16:76) or 'collateral-heir status' (kalala, 4:12/4:176); kalala in fact denotes the ABSENCE of the direct line - the opposite of totality - which blocks folding it into kull.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 16:76 wa-huwa kallun ala mawlahu reads the kal~N (fatha) nominal as 'a burden / dead-weight dependent upon his master' (of one who la yaqdiru ala shay) - a concrete predicate noun of incapacity/liability with zero quantificational content; it forms a near-minimal pair with the quantifier kul~ (damma) yet carries no readable 'totality/every' sense, and no Quran-internal occurrence bridges dependency-weight to exhaustive quantification.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A single-nucleus 'comprehensive encompassing' etymology unifying kull (totality), kalala (kin who 'encircle' laterally) and kall (a 'total' weight) under one root sense. Rejected because: (a) it is a classical-lexicon etymology, barred by the Quran-internal source policy; (b) Quran-internally kalala marks the ABSENCE of the direct line (anti-'totality'); (c) kall's ala-construction encodes weight/dependency with no quantificational trace; (d) no verse glosses one sense by another and no shared verb or collocation exists. A weaker competitor - that kull's core is mass 'entirety' with distributive 'every' derived - fits the data but is not adjudicable Quran-internally, so the neutral domain-exhaustion invariant is preferred as narrowest.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently partition the packet identically: 374 quantifier tokens (kull 358 N + kullama 16 T) under one adversarially-clean exhaustion nucleus, and 3 lexicalized nominals (kall x1, kalala x2) with no Quran-internal bridge to the quantifier or (cleanly) to each other. Within Class A/B the account is broad (60+ suras, every case/number realization), distinctive, and resistance-free - that sub-claim alone would support STRONG. Per the contract, however, a coherent resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE; here TWO exist (kall, kalala). Unity is a property of the WORD kull, not of the ROOT kll. We therefore report a dominant PREFERRED derivational-family claim graded MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE, explicitly holding the two nominals outside the nucleus rather than forcing a single root meaning (frequency 374/377 is not truth; absence of a bridge is not a bridge).

supporting_evidence.verse_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًٔا فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Single N-form nominal kal~N morphologically distinct (fatha vs the quantifier's damma) and semantically unbridged to kull; the ala ('upon') construction encodes weight resting on a patron. Resistant lexicalized nominal.

Two N-form nominals (kalalatan, al-kalala) whose sense is stipulated by legal context, never derived from any other kll word; denotes lateral/indirect kinship (anti-'totality'), so it cannot fold into kull. Resistant lexicalized nominal.

independent_verification: All three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) converged on the identical partition and on grading the root MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE with kall and kalala as resistant, non-bridged nominals.
candidate_root_contribution: The productive kull derivational family (kull + its transparent temporal compound kullama), covering 374/377 occurrences, contributes ONE Quran-internal nucleus: exhaustive quantification over a contextually-supplied domain - the totality of a set with no remainder - realized distributively ('every/each single X', with an indefinite-singular complement) or collectively ('all / the whole of it/them', with a definite antecedent + resumptive pronoun or ajmaun), and extended to occasions as kullama ('every time / whenever'). The distributive/collective alternation is contributed by the complement's definiteness/syntax, not by kull itself. This is the root's DOMINANT contribution but NOT a root-wide nucleus: two lexicalized nominals (kall, kalala) fall outside it with no demonstrated Quran-internal bridge.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 377 nominal occurrences read from the packet; surface census kul~i 191, kul~u 58, kul~a 59, kul~N 27, kul~FA 14, kul~K 10, kul~amaA/amaA^/kul~a(T) 16, kal~N 1, kalalapF/kalalapi 2; qac_verb_form null for all (no verbs).
layer_attribution.derivation: kullama (16 T tokens) is a transparent compound of kull + ma, sharing the exhaustion nucleus; kall and kalala are independent lexicalizations of the same consonantal skeleton with no derivational link to kull established Quran-internally.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One dominant quantifier lexeme kull (+ compound kullama), 374/377; plus two frozen content nominals - kall 'dependent burden' (1) and kalala 'collateral-heir status' (2).
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Distributive vs collective readings of kull are contributed by complement definiteness/syntax and ajmaun/jamian reinforcement; hyperbolic kull shay is context-bounded (46:25). This contextual/narrative shading refines but does NOT become the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: No preliminary dispositions required reversal; all three lenses agreed on first pass, so reconciliations is empty. The consistent quantifier clusters and the resistant nominal clusters were kept separate rather than merged.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: kall (16:76:12:1) and kalala (4:12:54:1, 4:176:6:2) remain unbridged to the quantifier nucleus and to each other; this residual resistance caps the root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and is preserved as a multi-class finding.

hard_cases.reason: kall 'burden/dependent' - near-minimal pair with the quantifier (fatha vs damma) but no quantificational sense and no Quran-internal bridge to kull.

evidence_basis.statement: 16:76:12:1 kall 'burden/dead-weight dependent upon his master' - concrete predicate noun of incapacity/liability, no quantificational content, no internal bridge to kull.

hard_cases.reason: kalala - stipulated collateral-inheritance term defined by absence of the direct line; anti-'totality', unbridged.

evidence_basis.statement: 4:12:54:1 (kalalatan) and 4:176:6:2 (al-kalala): a stipulated inheritance category for a decedent with no ascendant and no descendant whose collateral kin inherit - sense fixed by legal context (yurathu kalalatan / yaftikum fi al-kalala), denotes the ABSENCE of the direct line (anti-'totality'), never derived from any other kll word.

hard_cases.reason: kalala (definite al-kalala) - same frozen legal term, no derivation from any other kll word.

evidence_basis.statement: 4:12:54:1 (kalalatan) and 4:176:6:2 (al-kalala): a stipulated inheritance category for a decedent with no ascendant and no descendant whose collateral kin inherit - sense fixed by legal context (yurathu kalalatan / yaftikum fi al-kalala), denotes the ABSENCE of the direct line (anti-'totality'), never derived from any other kll word.

hard_case_representation.rationale: Three occurrences (16:76:12:1 kall; 4:12:54:1 and 4:176:6:2 kalala) persist as resistant lexicalized nominals outside the kull quantifier nucleus after adversarial testing across all three lenses; no Quran-internal bridge unifies them with the quantifier or (cleanly) with each other, so they are reported as RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases in a multi-class result rather than forced into a single nucleus.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence or construction that bridges the quantifier kull to kall (16:76) or kalala (4:12/4:176) - e.g. a verse glossing 'burden' or 'collateral-heir status' via 'totality/every', or a shared verb/collocation - which would collapse the multi-class partition into a single root nucleus and license a root-wide (ROOT_GENERALIZATION) claim.
rejection_condition.search_location: 16:76 (kall) and 4:12, 4:176 (kalala) read against the kull census (kull shay/nafs/umma, kullama, standalone kullun), plus any morphological neighbours; the whole packet of 377 occurrences.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-partition all 377 occurrences by qac_surface_form_buckwalter and form; test whether any kall/kalala context is Quran-internally paraphrasable by exhaustion/totality without importing lexica or etymology; seek shared verbs/collocations across the three classes.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude classical-lexicon etymology, dictionaries, tafsir and shared-consonant intuition (source policy); a mere shared triliteral skeleton or a hyperbolic kull shay is NOT a bridge; distinguish complement-driven distributive/collective alternation from a genuine sense split.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a genuine internal bridge is found, promote to research_state=PREFERRED with claim_scope=UNIVERSAL / claim_scope_kind=ROOT_GENERALIZATION and merge Clusters C/D into the nucleus; if instead the kull nucleus itself fractures, downgrade to research_state=UNRESOLVED / result_strength=UNRESOLVED.

reopen_conditions: A Quran-internal construction is found that paraphrases kall (16:76 kallun ala mawlahu) via exhaustion/totality, or that links 'burden/dependency' to the kull quantifier - bridging Cluster C into the nucleus.

kalala (4:12:54:1, 4:176:6:2) is shown Quran-internally to derive from or connect to kull/kullama (e.g. via a shared verb or an internal gloss), rather than being a stipulated legal term defined by absence of the direct line.

A clean Quran-internal thematic bridge is demonstrated between kall (dependent leaning on a mawla) and kalala (collateral kinship), or a bleached/idiomatic non-exhaustive use of kull is found that fractures the quantifier nucleus.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The kull/kullama exhaustion nucleus is adversarially clean and distinctive across 374/377 tokens (core holds), but the root-level unification is refuted by three resistant lexicalized nominals; because the CORE claim (dominant derivational family) holds while these occurrences resist a root-wide account, status is NOT_RUN with the resisting occurrences recorded, not PASSED (failing_occurrences non-empty) and not FAILED (core not refuted).
